reuse_policy: Purchased material supplies reasoning themes only, not exported stems, answers, choices or current labels. All characters, values and sequential dialogue are original synthetic material. Public clinical sources independently support provisional criteria; explicit author safety/communication inferences are not direct guideline recommendations. No Xi'an patient content is incorporated.
language_note: Chinese dialogue was composed for natural Chinese patient usage and paired against the English facts; schema retains machine_translation_unreviewed as its existing unapproved-language status. Neither language is professionally approved.
